svg.text: The operator node — a plan row is an unanswered artifact on one of its in-edges, and nothing else
created when its predicate first holds on a read · retracted by a word, or when the decision can no longer be made · the word is the only out-edge
the nodes whose artifacts land on a row edge

g.text: the tail counts from its time
proposal, no word → word · signals re-moved
proposal on open intent → word · intent closed
chore exit, no word → word on each
every unit finished, no hold → word · new unit

svg.text: a yes starts machinery only: instantiate, git.land

g.text: all elaborations done → close · keep · new elab
standing session idle → finish · keep · works
unit covers old version → amend · follow · landed
holds a session, heartbeat old → fresh · takeover
a word that could not apply → next rendering

svg.text: phone · page · a direct act on the store
the presenter is its adapter both ways
page + one chat message · same numbers
a row is a fact about the stores, evaluated on every read — no process emits it, so no restart can lose it; the number is fixed by the rendering, so a late reply still names its row
